units.translation: It is better for the sake of everything
so that you may learn the whole matter to the end
Why then do you hesitate to proclaim the whole matter?
I fall short by much and indeed by the whole
and with fortune fair of face to see and hear the whole matter for those who lament
and may they obtain the whole from the gods
they did not deem it worthy even to look upon the whole
he will attain the whole of his wits
and the whole grief from the land of Hellas, steadfast-hearted, is fitting for those who set forth from each house
the toils of the city being destroyed, the whole
a just lament seeks the whole, embracing all, having been stirred
you spoke the whole thing dishonorably
such things do the younger gods, ruling the whole more than justice
may I become black smoke, neighboring the clouds of Zeus, and wholly invisible –
who ever named her thus truly in regard to the whole?
a resident alien, for the whole always a stranger
the exile appointed by the Pythian oracle cried out to the whole
black and in every way loathsome
so as to release you from these toils for the whole
a faithful and just ally for the whole
they allotted to me root and branch for the whole
and for the whole I tell you, revere the altar of Justice
and libations for the whole, burning within the houses
so that he might be faithful for the whole of time
and I desire to hear your toils throughout
they are about to bring destruction upon the house of Agamemnon throughout
and the strife of good men, ours, prevails throughout
and before all things to me
it is necessary to address her with all words
it was proposed for all to be deprived of their heads
all with one stroke, wretched, gasp on the dry land
with the third, greatest of all, Zeus
and to all I say in common
the wealth dear to all and much prayed for
you will make the city just, all of you, passing your lives
most hateful to your brothers of all women who wear a girdle around their garments
the earth itself, which gives birth to all things
for someone pouring out all things in return
you will learn all things briefly
O Zeus father, all-perfect, in every way help
Capaneus threatens to do, prepared, dishonoring the gods
he is not responsible for these things, but you did the whole
